title: Prove exact phase entries for 2,304 denominator-52 tails
body:
**Exactly 2,304 of the 2,704 actual denominator-52 residue pairs have a unique entry into the existing nonzero denominator-13 arithmetic core after at most four coins.** This supplies the missing parameter, phase and live-node bindings for that part of the [PR #6096](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/6096) direct-graph question. It also proves that the first-entry inverse needs a separate boundary protocol. **No new kappa** or physical entry tariff is claimed.

Read the [proof and exact contract](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/5640f56b63ea04afc8505d45a4df1ea35466a94e/research/inverse52-phase-entry/PROOF.md), [entry formula](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/5640f56b63ea04afc8505d45a4df1ea35466a94e/research/inverse52-phase-entry/interface.py), [complete pair certificate](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/5640f56b63ea04afc8505d45a4df1ea35466a94e/research/inverse52-phase-entry/RESULT.json), [checker](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/5640f56b63ea04afc8505d45a4df1ea35466a94e/research/inverse52-phase-entry/verify.py), [29 source pins](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/5640f56b63ea04afc8505d45a4df1ea35466a94e/research/inverse52-phase-entry/SOURCE-PINS.json) and [credits](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/5640f56b63ea04afc8505d45a4df1ea35466a94e/research/inverse52-phase-entry/CREDITS.md).

The contract keeps the original order `00,01,10,11`, every unfinished node and the ordered coin suffix. For `13` dividing neither `a` nor `b`, the unique core parameters are `c = 10a mod13`, `d = 10b mod13`, with phase `theta = ab/(cd) mod169`. The 2,304 inputs use 1,560 distinct recipes. A separate inventory reconstructs all 22,464 core signatures from literal source transition labels and agrees with the formula.

| Actual input class | Pairs | Tail after four coins |
| --- | ---: | --- |
| Neither residue divisible by 13 | 2,304 | Unique entry into the current core |
| One residue zero, the other not divisible by 13 | 96 | Endpoint tail outside that contract |
| One residue in `{13,26,39}`, the other not divisible by 13 | 288 | Mixed tail outside that contract |
| Both residues divisible by 13 | 16 | No unfinished tail |

The exclusion concerns this complete-pool interface only. It does not exclude other controllers, endpoint dispatch or state encodings. Early leaves use fewer than four coins; `(0,0)` uses none. An unfinished pool must not be replaced by a fresh one-root sample without a proof.

All 2,704 bounded owner witnesses, 43,264 literal four-coin prefixes and 1,437,696 eligible tail transitions pass. The entry-specific inverse passes for all 4,428 continuing entry nodes. At the actual source pair `(1,1)`, prefix `1111` enters core phase 120, node zero; its prefix predecessor is phase eight, node zero, while the core cyclic predecessor is phase 60, node one. A transition that merges both inputs into the same output and clears its workspace cannot be reversible. A separate entry/return protocol can work. No universal extra-bit lower bound is proved.

Python 3.12, standard library only:

```sh
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/inverse52-phase-entry
```

Both registered commands print:

```text
PASS_INVERSE52_PHASE_ENTRY
2704 actual pairs; 2304 pairs with a unique core entry; 96 endpoint tails; 288 mixed tails; 16 dyadic pairs
22464 backend phase signatures; 43264 literal prefixes; 1437696 tail edges
4428 entry inverse checks; explicit first-entry/period-return collision
```

Normal and optimized registered replay, syntax/indentation, committed bytes/source history/modes, export and sealed read-only Git-free serial replay pass. The complete unchanged PR7755 verifier also runs, including its circuit and fixed-pair checks. Hosted CI did not certify this package. The [plan job](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/44422280413/job/135218027303) failed in the shared `test_current_ci_section_matches_selected_record`: the base guide names frontier6030 while the selected record requires `make frontier7000-verify`. The log reports 760 tests, one failure and 24 skipped; package replay was skipped. This package changes no shared CI file. Local replay remains the scientific evidence.

@JoyboyBrian supplied the [actual residue image and nonadaptive arithmetic window](https://github.com/JoyboyBrian/integer-mult-bounds/blob/e56f5094c83f3e514d9936fa7b1c8027745a0a00/research/inverse-residue-domain/README.md), [domain checker](https://github.com/JoyboyBrian/integer-mult-bounds/blob/e56f5094c83f3e514d9936fa7b1c8027745a0a00/research/inverse-residue-domain/verify.py) and direct-graph question in PR6096. The exact [mode columns](https://github.com/JoyboyBrian/integer-mult-bounds/blob/e56f5094c83f3e514d9936fa7b1c8027745a0a00/research/coded-native-caller/NORMALIZERS.json) are retained. Ali Romman (@aliromman), with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance, supplied the [runtime core](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/d6babec41a3d01928c3dbdb896ea2adf051ba305/research/runtime-paired-ddg-arithmetic/README.md) and [replay](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/d6babec41a3d01928c3dbdb896ea2adf051ba305/research/runtime-paired-ddg-arithmetic/verify.py) in [PR #7755](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7755). Its whole package is retained byte for byte.

That package credits Nick Petalas (@petalas) for the [PR #7746](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7746) arithmetic primitives, @zxv for the [PR #6072](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/6072) paired graph and probability proof, and @JoyboyBrian for the [PR #6102](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/6102) inverse/lifecycle context. All retained notices and predecessor credits remain. The numerical caller in [PR #6546](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/6546) is a distinct result; this PR does not claim that numerical caller joining is globally absent.

Physical prefix execution, parameter loading, entry/return control, wire/tape access, stopping storage, output retention, conditional freshness and the complete native invoice remain open. The complete source-domain kernel fixtures, historical probability/mean catalogue, native/selected cold replay, Lean and Docker were not run. All five framework assumptions and the selected frontier remain unchanged.
